title: Super Kings Clinch Thrilling 36-Run T20 Derby Victory
author: CSK Media Team
excerpt: Captain Rajesh Sharmas unbeaten 68 and clinical bowling from Barrett and Al-Mansoor secured the points against George Town Tigers.
content:
A packed Jimmy Powell Oval was treated to a masterclass in aggressive T20 cricket as Cayman Super Kings overcame cross-town rivals George Town Tigers by 36 runs on Sunday afternoon.

Winning the toss and electing to bat first on a dry, true pitch, CSK got off to an explosive start courtesy of opener Arun Kumar (42 off 31 balls). After Devon Campbell fell for 24, skipper Rajesh Sharma joined Marcus Sterling at the crease and shifted gears effortlessly.

Sharma dismantled the Tigers bowling attack in the closing overs, striking 6 fours and 3 colossal sixes into the palm trees behind deep square leg on his way to an unbeaten 68 off 44 balls. Supported by late cameos from Karan Patel and Sanjay Wright, CSK posted an imposing 178/4 in their 20 overs.

Disciplined Bowling Defense

Defending 179, opening bowler Rohan Barrett struck in his very first over, clean-bowling the Tigers opener with a 86mph yorker. Tariq Al-Mansoor maintained relentless pressure from the Southern End, finishing with 2/28. Despite a stubborn middle-order stand, Sharma returned with ball in hand to claim two vital wickets and extinguish any threat of a comeback.

The Tigers were restricted to 142/9, sparking jubilant scenes among the traveling yellow-and-navy faithful.

title: Marcus Sterling Smashes 104 as Super Kings Dominate 40-Over Cup
author: CSK Media Team
excerpt: A sublime hundred from the vice-captain set up a commanding 248 total against Seven Mile Strikers.
content:
Marcus Sterling stamped his authority on the 2026 40-Over Cup campaign with a breathtaking 104 off 92 deliveries at Smith Road Oval.

Sterling stroked 11 elegant boundaries and cleared the ropes three times, reaching his three-figure landmark with a crunching pull shot to the midwicket boundary. Together with Arun Kumar (38) and Rajesh Sharma (41), CSK built an unassailable total of 248/7.

Rohan Barrett then claimed 4 for 38 in a devastating opening spell to leave Strikers in tatters early in the chase.

title: CSK Youth Academy Expands for Autumn 2026 Intake
author: Youth Coaching Staff
excerpt: Registration opens for young cricketers aged 10-18 across Grand Cayman. Mentorship from senior national and league players included.
content:
Cayman Super Kings are delighted to announce the expansion of our grassroots Youth Development Pathway for the upcoming autumn term.

The programme operates across three age brackets: Under-12 Foundation, Under-15 Development, and Under-19 Elite. Sessions will be hosted twice weekly at Jimmy Powell Oval, covering batting biomechanics, modern spin variations, seam discipline, and high-intensity athletic fielding.

All youth training adheres strictly to safeguarding and child welfare guidelines established by the Cayman Islands Cricket Association.

title: Club Unveils 2026/27 Corporate Partnership Programme
author: CSK Executive Committee
excerpt: New tier opportunities for Cayman businesses to support local amateur sport, community cricket, and grassroots coaching.
content:
Ahead of the upcoming championship finals and the 2027 season, Cayman Super Kings have opened partnership slots across Premier, Club, and Community tiers.

Partners gain valuable local visibility across matchday gear, digital channels reaching thousands of Cayman residents, and direct association with the island fastest-growing cricket franchise.
